name: briefing_runtime_build_objective_actions_from_index
description: HudUiBriefingRuntime::BuildObjectiveActionsFromIndex builds the per-objective briefing action sequence and activates queue playback.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Briefing runtime/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x404400 validates the network early return, briefing sample-name format, mission id lookup, per-objective title formatting, objective string/image lookup, action insertion order, progress id progression, sequence-active flag, global sequence flag, current-node initialization, and return value.

The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies the network early return and the full action sequence for two objectives, including action order, targets, text/image payloads, progress ids, sequence flags, and current-node state.
